faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Basset Hound?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 40-65 lb (18-29 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Basset Hound?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Ear infections; Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD) risk; Glaucoma risk. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Basset Hound at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Basset Hound default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
